en.title: 3D: a library of 24 models made in code
en.body: `examples/models` holds twenty-four models made from distance fields, each checked from four sides: a fox, cat, dog, rabbit, chick and fish; a villager and a knight; a cottage, well, watchtower and pagoda; a tree, pine, bush, flower, mushroom and cactus; a barrel, crate, chest, lantern, rock and signpost. Each file says in a comment which parts it is made of; the README lists the lessons making them taught; a gallery page makes and shows them all; a test keeps every model within its triangle budget, on the ground and at the size of its kind. The model-in-code guide card now starts from them. `sdfIntersect` takes its colour from the parts that have one, so a part used only to cut no longer paints the cut white.

zh.title: 3D：24 个用代码做的范例模型
zh.body: `examples/models` 收录二十四个用距离场做的模型，每个都从四个方向检查过：狐狸、猫、狗、兔子、小鸡和鱼；村民和骑士；小屋、水井、瞭望塔和宝塔；树、松树、灌木、花、蘑菇和仙人掌；木桶、木箱、宝箱、灯笼、石头和路牌。每个文件的注释写明由哪些零件组成；README 列出做它们时学到的经验；画廊页面生成并展示全部模型；测试保证每个模型不超面数预算、立在地面上、大小符合它的种类。model-in-code guide 卡片现在从这些模型开始。`sdfIntersect` 从有颜色的零件取色，只用来切的零件不会再把切面染成白色。
